component.name: NI on Linux
component.summary: Native Access, NI products and Windows VSTs in Linux DAWs

description.p: Runs Native Instruments' Native Access and the products it installs on Linux, and makes them available to Linux DAWs. It manages its own Wine environment, applies every fix Native Access needs, installs NI applications whose installers do not run under Wine, runs third-party plugin installers, and bridges VST2, VST3 and CLAP plugins with yabridge — without the user ever dealing with Wine.

Native Access is not included: download it from native-instruments.com (the app links to the page) and choose the file in the app. Requires an NI account. A portable Wine build is downloaded on first run.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Native Instruments GmbH.

description.p: CI: install libdbus-1-dev for the yabridge build
Route the wine shim by prefix so a host Wine keeps its own prefixes
CI: decide the release skip from the commit subject only
Share /tmp so DAW plugins and the NTK daemon use one wineserver

Flatpak fixes: a writable default download location for Native Access, 32-bit NI installers run (multiarch), the prefix is repaired if another Wine rewrote it, and DAWs are made to run bridged plugins with the app's own Wine. Trace parser fix for application installs.
First release: own Wine environment with every Native Access fix, install of NI applications whose installers fail under Wine, third-party plugin installers, yabridge bridging, GTK4 GUI and CLI.
